notes.title: Easter event! v0.3.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/f0cef7d4f1ca40b9529c482624448c9568c0f7c7.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]We have a hunt for you![/b][/h1]
At SoulHunt we are celebrating Easter with a hunt - what else did you expect? 
This week you do not only have to hunt down souls, but also our psychedelic Easter eggs! 

We have hidden 120 eggs over our 8 SoulHunt maps. Up to you to find them! Per 10 eggs that you find, you receive a special customization item. 
Collecting eggs can simply be done by possesing the eggs as a hider or by shooting the eggs as a seeker. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/dd6f633aea62125d9b5151fe37fb70b518017974.jpg[/img]

Enjoy and Happy Easter!

As the holidays are passing we have been working on a new patch! We squashed some bugs here and there, added new customization items in SoulHunt and added checkpoints in SoulRace.

[h1][b]New Soul Skins[/b][/h1]
New soul skins have been added to the game. Check them out in the customization screen! 

[h1][b]SoulRace Checkpoints[/b][/h1]
We have added checkpoints in the soul race maps, so when you get killed, you do not have to start all over. You will spawn from the checkpoint you have last reached.

notes.title: Demo out now! Play for free! v0.1.1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/d203d089de84542180bf088a8932fede10a6c915.png[/img]

[h1][b]Demo release[/b][/h1]
Are your friends playing SoulHunt? Do you want to play along, but you don’t have the game yet? Well you could of course always just buy the game too, we would like that :) 

But we understand that you want try before you buy, so we have come up with a solution. Drumroll please … We now have a DEMO! We have released a demo version where you can try the game out for free for a limited period of time.

With our demo version, you will be able to play both with people who only have the demo, and with people who have actually bought the game. Go hunt those Souls! 

[h1][b]Discount for a limited time![/b][/h1]
We also have SoulHunt on sale for a limited time so be quick if you want to buy the game!

[h1][b]Main menu refresh[/b][/h1]
The main menu screen has been updated to make it easier to get started in a room. However, you will still be able to create and join custom games just like it used to be.

[h1][b]Bug fixes[/b][/h1]
Synchronization issue of player movement has been fixed! (Shoutout to Rubixus and Connor!)

We also fixed a bug where you got disconnected when a new players joins the room while you as the master client were still loading the map. If you like to see what technically the problem was you can check out the forum post [url=http://forum.photonengine.com/discussion/10894/analyzing-disconnects-of-the-master-client]here[/url]

Networking performance improvements should also decrease the amount of disconnects.

notes.title: New Game Mode SoulRace! Patch v0.1.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/a8d4f3843136e89897b23b7410734e29028908f4.png[/img]

[h1][b]New game mode[/b][/h1]
As we have been working on smaller features, we also have been working on our new game mode “SoulRace”. This game mode is finally ready for release! [Insert joy] Check out our trailer [url=https://youtu.be/OwOIsJDoDs0]here[/url].

[img]https://fat.gfycat.com/ShrillIndolentItalianbrownbear.gif[/img]

Now, how does this new game mode work? You will be a random prop, for example a chicken, a fetus, a fire extinguisher, etc. and with this prop you will have to race for your life and reach the end point first. Easy right? 

[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/LegitimateElatedJackal.gif[/img]

Here is the catch, you will be annoyed by your fellow players. Push each other off cliffs, force ragdoll states, breakdance right in the middle of jumps... Only those skilled enough will survive and leave their friends behind.

[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/RashJampackedDevilfish.gif[/img]

2.500 points are given to the winner of the race, but you will also get points for killing off other players. On the other hand you will also lose points if you die yourself. 

[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/UnhealthyShabbyCottonmouth.gif[/img]

Now let the race begin!

[b][u]Patch notes v0.1.0 08/18/2017:[/u][/b]
[h1][u]New Features[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new game mode: SoulRace.
[*] Added basic scoring system.
[*] Added game rounds, after an amount of rounds the map will change.
[*] Added stats on scoreboard.
[/list]
[h1][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Robot sensor skill how to play text not matching actual time of skill.
[*] Fixed bug of loading the main menu 3 times.
[/list]
[h1][u]Updates[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed jump mechanics, now you can jump once even when you are not grounded.
[*] Player tags of your team will always show on top of your screen.
[*] Sprint will not consume soul power when you are not moving.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.0.4b: Nerfing Hiders, Buffing Hunters!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/2c78cb7579c60606ff0efd986850dff8e94d02e4.png[/img]

[h1][b]Hiders get stronger[/b][/h1]
After some feedback and suggestions, we have slightly updated some skills to match the powers of the hunters.

[b][u]Patch notes V0.0.4b 05/07/2017:[/u][/b]
[h1][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Lit candles now should trigger the achievement when winning.
[/list]
[h1][u]Updates[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*] Haunted props will now damage hunters more when shooting the haunted prop.
[*] Hear heartbeat now costs 15 soul power.
[*] Silence heartbeat skill now also stops the soul trail emission.
[*] Changed silence heartbeat action duration from 2 to 3 seconds.
[*] Changed silence heartbeat cooldown duration from 10 to 5 seconds.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.0.4: Voice chat + Mirrored levels!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/a0d716d4cc3a9572b640c38ec0012cfab1d9a8f3.png[/img]

[h1][b]Map Update[/b][/h1]
As development is ongoing we decided to shuffle up the maps, including more props and different hiding spots! There should also be an overall performance improvement. We are currently working on a new map and other features, more details are soon to be revealed!

[h1][b]Voice Chat[/b][/h1]
Voice Chat has been implemented with two types of voice chat:

[u]Positional Voice Chat[/u]
Positional voice chat is voice chat where everyone can hear you in the world independent from your team. This will be hearable based on the distance between players.

[u]Team Voice Chat[/u]
Team voice chat can be heard from all over the map but is excluded to your team only.

[/list]

[list]
[*] All clients will now trigger visibility correctly after a damage skill for Reapers.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.0.3a: AoE Attack Changes!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/fe0c08468b7390731151bdc1336d79e169811fed.png[/img]

[h1] AoE attack changes![/h1]
The secondary explosion (AoE) attack will now be obstructed by obstacles like walls/doors and other static objects souls might be hiding in/behind. This will force the hunters to hunt more thoroughly in order to find and collect their souls!

[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/GreenSlowGreatwhiteshark.gif[/img]

[b][u]Patch notes V0.0.3a 01/29/2017:[/u][/b]
[h1][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Reaper now does not dissolve on death anymore.
[*]Props won't get damaged anymore when deactivated.
[*]Checks now done on the players playing in the round to check who is the winner instead of all the instantiated players.
[/list]
[h1][u]Updates[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Invisibility skill now will cancel the action when doing a damage skill.
[*]AoE now has line of sight checks from the AoE position to the player.
[*]Added self damage of 5 health to the hunter when hitting obstructed players.
[*]Win text now has a color depending on the winner.
[*]Skins: Updated santa pants.
[*]Scene: Removed christmas assets.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.0.3: Moving Ragdolled Props!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/3bf9065bb9444b21e2895cadb2b621da91ca288d.png[/img]
With the provided feedback we've received, a few balance changes were made and also the the ability to apply torque to your possessed object while in ragdoll state has been added. Feel free to further provide us with feedback and ideas as it can only help us improve the game with the upcoming patches!

[img]https://giant.gfycat.com/DisloyalSadFurseal.gif[/img]

[b][u]Patch notes V0.0.3 15/01/2017:[/u][/b]
[h1][u]New Features[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Movement buttons will now apply torque to your possessed prop in ragdoll state as a hider.
[*]Added new hat for the reaper.
[*]Added church bells sound effects when going into game state on the graveyard map.
[/list]
[h1][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Animated props will now animate properly on remote clients.
[/list]
[h1][u]Updates[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Soul Trail[/b]: Changed the way soul trail works on hiders. The soul trail will not emit when possessing into something
[*][b]Soul Trail[/b]: The soul trail also won't emit when in ragdoll state.
[*][b]Hunter's AoE Attack[/b]:Updated self damage to 15 instead of 10 when not hitting a player with AoE attacks.
[*][b]Hunter's Single Shot[/b]: Lowered cooldown of singleshot from 0.2s to 0.15s.
[/list]

notes.title: Christmas Update! Patch Notes V0.0.2
notes.content:
First little update after the launch!

As we know a lot of people will be celebrating the holidays with friends and family, we want you to enjoy it to the fullest. For a limited time in SoulHunt you will not only be able to a present itself (literally). You can also collect souls as Santa Reaper!

Have a wonderful Christmas and New Year’s Eve everyone!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26830972/2034a89fab63b75f219b97414c440426db0e9a52.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Patch notes V0.0.2 25/12/2016[/u][/b]:
[h1][u]New Features[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Reaper Christmas customization items.
[/list]
[h1][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Y mouse movement speed now being updated from saved settings on startup.
[*]Chat accidentally scrolling.
[*]Players will now be correctly deactivated when players leave.
[*]Poop prop in hospital scene not falling through the ground anymore.
[/list]
[h1][u]Updates[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Christmas props have been added to the maps. 
[*]Player tags to billboard face the camera.
[*]Removed work in progress game modes.
[*]Player tags show the correct layout for devs.
[/list]
